slots.name: bank sample
slots.sentence: Our sample for 2019Q4 includes 143 regional banks and 41 large banks.

slots.name: CRE loan exposure
slots.unit: percent of regional-bank loans; large banks 16.8 percent
slots.sentence: Regionals banks have substantial commercial real estate (CRE) loan exposure measuring 41.6 percent of their total loans vs. 16.8 percent for large banks.

slots.name: state deposit share
slots.sentence: The sum of shares for the top 5 states is around 34 percent, which closely reflects the share in U.S. GDP of these 5 states.

slots.name: CET1 projection gap
slots.sentence: PPNR projections account for about two thirds of the overall change in the CET1 projections, and the NCO projections account for about one third of the overall change.
